title.zh: 隨行風扇 ｜ 品牌商品視覺設計

description.zh: 為品牌商品設定視覺語言，並保持品牌的視覺調性，與風格、其他商品視覺統一化；設計內容覆蓋銷售頁面、3D 素材、素材廣告與社群內容等。
description.en: Built the visual language for this product and kept it consistent with the rest of the brand's lineup. Covers the sales page, 3D assets, ad creatives and social content.

detailedDescription.zh: 為品牌的隨行風扇製作完整商品視覺，涵蓋3D渲染、主視覺及廣告素材。
detailedDescription.en: A full visual package for a portable fan — 3D renders, key visuals, and ad creatives.

overview.zh:
這款風扇造型偏向直筒，同時內建行動電源功能，為了幫助消費者直覺理解，我用 3D 渲染製作了多角度、多型態的產品素材，清楚展示商品的外觀與使用方式。

一頁式的結構上，我刻意將兩個功能拆成兩段來說，避免同時接收雙重訊息造成認知負擔：前段聚焦風扇功能，用動態圖示範切換型態的前後對比，讓使用方式一目了然；後段再帶出行動電源的使用情境，以生活場景收尾，讓消費者自然想像商品融入日常的樣子。
overview.en:
This fan has a straight, cylindrical body and doubles as a power bank. To make that easy to grasp at a glance, I rendered it from multiple angles and in both of its forms, so people can see exactly what it looks like and how it works.

For the sales page, I deliberately split the two functions into separate sections instead of pushing both at once — two messages at the same time is one too many. The first half stays on the fan itself, using motion graphics to show the before-and-after of switching modes. The second half brings in the power bank, closing on everyday scenarios so people can picture it in their own routine.

title.zh: 電源供應器 ｜ 品牌商品視覺設計

description.zh: 以多功能行動電源為主軸，設定商品視覺語言並維持品牌調性；設計內容涵蓋銷售頁面、3D素材、廣告與社群內容。
description.en: Visual direction for a multi-function power bank, kept in line with the brand's existing tone. Sales page, 3D assets, ads and social content.

detailedDescription.zh: 為品牌的電源供應器製作3D渲染、主視覺及廣告素材等視覺設計。
detailedDescription.en: 3D renders, key visuals and ad creatives for a brand's power adapter.

overview.zh:
有別於需要建立使用情境的新商品，行動電源屬於消費者已熟悉的品項
視覺敘事的重點因此從『說明需求』的提出痛點，轉向『突顯差異』：以多功能、自帶線等產品特色為核心，設計涵蓋銷售頁面、3D素材、廣告與社群內容。
overview.en:
Unlike a new product category that needs its use case explained, a power bank is something people already understand.
So the story shifts from "here's the problem" to "here's what makes this one different" — the built-in cable, the two-in-one design. That thinking carried through the sales page, 3D assets, ads and social posts.

description.zh: 作為使用AI的嘗試，此次將3D渲染圖放進了Gemini當中，並以提示詞要求結合渲染圖產出產品素材，最後使用Photoshop進行圖片編輯與排版設計。
description.en: An experiment with AI in the workflow — I fed my own 3D renders into Gemini and prompted it to build out product scenes around them, then finished the editing and layout in Photoshop.

body.zh: 於商品上架品牌官網時發佈，以「新商品」作為文案開頭，文字描述簡單輕鬆、並將商品特色以條列式展出，讓追蹤者能快速了解新品的特色。
body.en: Posted when the product went live on the brand site. Opens with a straightforward "new arrival" hook, keeps the tone light, and lists the specs so followers can take it in quickly.

description.zh: 使用Premiere與Effect剪輯品牌形象、產品展示，以及其他興趣剪輯
description.en: Brand films, product demos and personal edits, cut in Premiere and After Effects

description.zh: 負責品牌的概念短影片剪輯，主要使用Premiere做初步剪輯與調色、速度微調等。
description.en: A concept short for the brand — cut, graded and speed-adjusted in Premiere.

description.zh: 使用Blender進行建模與動畫渲染，最後使用Adobe Premiere進行剪輯串場。此影片用於品牌網站的部分背景區塊。
description.en: Modeled and animated in Blender, then assembled in Premiere. Used as a background section on the brand's website.

description.zh: 《葬送のフリーレン》動畫片段剪輯，主要使用Effect製作字體動畫與過場。
description.en: An anime clip edit, mostly an excuse to play with kinetic typography and transitions in After Effects.

description.zh: VTuber實況精華/Short剪輯，主要使用Effect與網路素材。
description.en: VTuber stream highlights and Shorts, built in After Effects with sourced assets.

description.zh: 3C 產品建模，用於電商平台展示，以及素材製作等多種用途
description.en: Consumer electronics modeled for e-commerce listings and design assets

detailedDescription.zh: 為電商平台打造的產品 3D 模型，注重材質真實感與細節呈現。透過建模與燈光設計，讓產品在網頁上也能展現出更清晰的外型。建模完成後，改色、改角度、換情境都不需要重新送樣拍攝。
detailedDescription.en: 3D product models built for e-commerce, with attention to material believability and fine detail. Modeling and lighting do the work, so the product reads clearly on screen. And once the model exists, a colour change, a new angle or a different scene doesn't mean shipping another sample to a photographer.

description.zh: 一頁式商品介紹設計，簡潔明瞭的展現商品優勢
description.en: Single-page product stories that get the point across fast

detailedDescription.zh: 把商品資訊排成一段有順序的說服流程：先讓人認出自己的痛點與需求，再帶出功能，最後才收到行動。一步步說服人按下購買。
detailedDescription.en: A sales page is an ordered argument, not a collage — first let someone recognise their own problem, then introduce the feature, and only then ask for the action. Step by step, up to the buy button.

description.zh: 產品主視覺、Banner 等，強化品牌一致的視覺形象
description.en: Key visuals and banners that keep the brand's look consistent

detailedDescription.zh: 針對電商平台設計的視覺素材，包含產品主視覺、促銷 Banner、以及商品詳情頁設計。我會將視覺融合品牌調性，讓人在認識商品的同時也把品牌風格放進記憶，建立品牌印象。
detailedDescription.en: Visual assets for e-commerce platforms — product key visuals, promo banners, and detail page layouts. I keep the brand's tone inside the product visual, so learning what the product is and remembering who made it happen at the same time.

description.en: Post visuals for Instagram and Facebook

detailedDescription.zh: 為社群平台設計的系列視覺內容,維持品牌調性的同時，針對不同平台特性調整視覺比例與資訊呈現方式；並根據不同風格，產出符合需求的文案。
detailedDescription.en: Social content built as a series — same brand voice throughout, but with the proportions and information density adjusted for each platform. Copy written to match, too.

description.zh: 根據季節、節日等設計活動視覺圖，以清晰明瞭的視覺呈現優惠活動，用以吸引追蹤者的目光，並增加其轉換率
description.en: Campaign visuals for seasons and holidays, laying the offer out as plainly as possible to catch a follower's eye and lift conversion.

description.zh: 為品牌 IG 設計的「知識懶人包」，用於提高品牌互動、增加其他點擊率
description.en: Explainer carousels for the brand's Instagram, made to raise engagement and drive clicks elsewhere.

description.zh: 以符合平台規格，設計產品的數位廣告素材
description.en: Digital ad creatives built to each platform's spec

detailedDescription.zh: 同一組素材要同時適應 Facebook 與 LINE 的比例與文字面積限制。我的做法是先定一個可裁切的主視覺結構，再依各平台重排，而不是每個尺寸重畫一次。
detailedDescription.en: The same creative has to survive both Facebook's and LINE's aspect ratios and text-area limits. I build one key visual on a crop-safe structure and re-lay it out per platform, instead of redrawing it at every size.

description.zh: 以興趣驅動的個人插畫創作
description.en: Personal illustration work — no particular theme, just whatever I feel like drawing

detailedDescription.zh:
繪圖一直是我生活裡的一部分。就像嘗試不同的設計風格一樣，我喜歡讓畫風自由變化——題材可能是日常的觀察，也可能是某個說不清楚的心情。
對我來說，畫畫是一種紀錄生活的方式。
detailedDescription.en:
Drawing has always been part of my life. Much like trying on different design styles, I like letting the way I draw shift around — sometimes it's something I noticed during the day, sometimes it's a mood I can't quite name.
Mostly it's just how I keep track of things.
